limits: Four original definitions only, not the whole server suite. No production source edits or main integration yet.

All HTTP is synthetic loopback through ordinary NativeHttpClient/Gateway; original #9 alone uses its supplied evaluator response. No live provider/model/download, OAuth exchange, transport promotion, performance or cross-platform qualification.

Actual request equality is complete parsed JSON plus six selected original semantic headers/method/path. Other captured headers and raw HTTP framing are retained reference observations, not blanket native equality claims.

Complete raw Node I/O chunks and chronological assertion observations are retained separately. Stable projections are validated latency, generated UUID, automatic HTTP date and exact loopback authority; UTF8 replaces redundant base64 only after roundtrip validation.
Native owned-peer header8KiB/64entries, body2MiB,8calls/8connections,5s deadlines/cleanup and1KiB bounded sticky errors are fixture bounds; no change to production limits.
Helper author root; this implementation author validation_2; independent capture and helper judgments are CLI349a/22a. Final native independent review remains separate.
